about.heading: Who We Are
about.body: The Robotics and AV Club is a student-driven community of innovators, engineers, and creators. We build cutting-edge robots, automate systems, produce high-quality audio-visual content, and compete at state and national levels. Our club bridges the gap between imagination and engineering — giving every member the tools, mentorship, and platform to turn ambitious ideas into reality.

areas.title: Robotics
areas.description: We design, build, and program autonomous and remote-controlled robots for competitions and real-world problem solving.

areas.title: Automation
areas.description: From smart systems to IoT projects, we engineer automation solutions that solve everyday challenges.

areas.title: AV Production
areas.description: We produce high-quality audio-visual content — event coverage, promo videos, livestreams and more.

areas.title: Software & AI
areas.description: From firmware to machine learning, our members write the code that powers intelligent systems.

cta.heading: Ready to Build the Future?
cta.body: Join the Robotics & AV Club and be part of a community that creates, competes, and innovates.
